description: Scaffold of the Xero app emulator: it launches as --port=N, answers GET /admin/health with {"status":"ok"}, and serves the shared admin plane (reset, state, config, quirks), issues tokens at POST /connect/token for the authorization_code, refresh_token and client_credentials grants, and lists tenant connections at GET /connections (bearer-authenticated). Under /api.xro/2.0 it serves GET Organisation and GET Accounts (a seeded demo chart of 8 accounts, per tenant) and PUT Contacts (creates contacts per tenant, accepting {Contacts:[...]} or a bare contact; the emulator assigns ContactID and defaults status to ACTIVE; it validates each contact: a name is required, fields keep to their lengths, names are unique among active contacts, account numbers are unique, and any invalid contact refuses the whole request with a 400 ValidationException that echoes every contact) and GET Contacts (lists a tenant's contacts, filtered by where, including a single = as well as ==, IDs, searchTerm and includeArchived, with summaryOnly and page-numbered pagination: the pagination object appears only when page is sent, and the summary form is returned without page; the order parameter and If-Modified-Since are not served yet) and PUT Invoices (creates invoices per tenant, accepting {Invoices:[...]} or a bare invoice and answering 200 with the plural envelope; computed and read-only fields are ignored, line amounts and totals are computed, AmountDue starts at Total, status defaults to DRAFT, and ACCREC invoices are numbered INV-0001 style; a new invoice is validated: Type, Status, Contact, InvoiceNumber length and per-Type uniqueness, AccountCode and line presence, and by default any invalid invoice refuses the whole request with a 400 ValidationException that echoes every invoice, and with summarizeErrors=false the valid invoices are created and each refused one is answered in place with 200, HasErrors true, StatusAttributeString ERROR and its ValidationErrors; created invoices carry StatusAttributeString OK, or WARNING when SentToContact is sent true on a non-AUTHORISED invoice; the status and warning wording is unverified) and POST Invoices/{InvoiceID} (updates one invoice named by ID or number, accepting {Invoices:[...]} or a bare invoice; only the fields the body carries change, so a whole invoice read earlier can be sent back with one field changed; Type cannot change, the changed invoice is validated as on create, and a refused update is a 400 ValidationException, or with summarizeErrors=false a 200 with the errors in place; SentToContact true on a non-AUTHORISED, non-PAID, non-VOIDED, non-DELETED invoice is stored false with StatusAttributeString WARNING, so a void or delete keeps SentToContact as stored; an unknown invoice is a 404; amounts, IDs and payments are ignored; LineItems are matched by LineItemID, so a known ID updates that line, a line without one is added, an omitted line is deleted, and lines sent without IDs replace every line, with line amounts and totals recomputed, AccountID resolved from AccountCode, and a LineAmountTypes change recomputing the stored tax; a Status change follows Xero's documented table (DRAFT and SUBMITTED move among DRAFT, SUBMITTED, AUTHORISED and DELETED; AUTHORISED can only be voided; PAID, VOIDED and DELETED have no changes), so {Status: DELETED} deletes and {Status: VOIDED} voids, a void is refused when the invoice has payments, a VOIDED or DELETED invoice cannot be updated again, AmountDue is 0 once voided or deleted, and a paid invoice refuses changes to Status, totals, LineAmountTypes, CurrencyCode and Date; the 404 body and refusal wording are unverified) and GET Invoices (lists a tenant's invoices, filtered by where, including Contact.ContactID, the optional dates and a single = as well as ==, by the IDs, InvoiceNumbers, ContactIDs and Statuses filters, the GUID ones case-insensitive, and by searchTerm on InvoiceNumber and Reference, with page-numbered pagination: the pagination object appears only when page is sent, and the summary form, without line items, is returned without page; summaryOnly equals the unpaged form; a malformed where is a 400 ValidationException; order and If-Modified-Since are not served yet; includeArchived, createdByMyApp and unitdp are accepted and change nothing; which fields the summary form drops and the searchTerm fields are unverified) and GET Invoices/{InvoiceID} (one invoice in the plural envelope, by ID in any case or by InvoiceNumber; an unknown one is a 404 whose problem-details body is unverified) and POST Payments (records payments per tenant, accepting {Payments:[...]} or a bare payment and answering 200 with the plural envelope; each payment is validated: the invoice, by ID or number, and the account, by ID or code, must exist, Date is required and Amount must be above zero, PaymentType is derived from the invoice type, and any invalid payment refuses the whole request with a 400 ValidationException; a valid payment is applied to its invoice, updating AmountPaid, AmountDue and FullyPaidOnDate, setting status PAID when settled and adding an entry to the invoice Payments, with the payments in one request applied in order; a payment is refused with the same 400 ValidationException when the invoice is not AUTHORISED, the account is not a BANK account or lacks EnablePaymentsToAccount, the amount is above AmountDue, or it is a prepayment or overpayment payment; a payment may instead name a CreditNote, by ID or number, and is then a refund (ARCREDITPAYMENT for ACCRECCREDIT): by default the credit note may be AUTHORISED or already PAID and the payments on it may add up to its Total, the payment lowers RemainingCredit and the credit note becomes PAID at zero, and under strict_auth the credit note must be AUTHORISED and the amount within RemainingCredit, both rules being guesses declared as alloc-001 and alloc-002; BankAmount equals Amount with CurrencyRate not converted; only the invoice status wording is verified, the other refusal wording is unverified) and POST Payments/{PaymentID} (deletes a payment by a status write, bare or in a {Payments:[...]} envelope: only Status DELETED is read, the payment stays in the tenant as DELETED, and its invoice goes back to before the payment, with AmountPaid down, AmountDue restored, PAID returning to AUTHORISED with FullyPaidOnDate cleared, and the payment's entry dropped from the invoice Payments; deleting a credit note payment instead restores the credit note's RemainingCredit and status; any other status, an already DELETED payment and a reconciled payment are refused with a 400 ValidationException, and an unknown payment is a 404; the refusal wording and the dropped invoice Payments entry are guesses declared as crud-002) and PUT CreditNotes (creates credit notes per tenant, accepting {CreditNotes:[...]} or a bare credit note and answering 200 with the plural envelope; line amounts and totals are computed with the same rules as invoices, RemainingCredit starts at Total, status defaults to DRAFT, and ACCRECCREDIT credit notes are numbered CN-0001 style; a new credit note is validated: Type, Status, Contact, CreditNoteNumber length and per-Type uniqueness, AccountCode and line presence, and summarizeErrors works as it does for invoices; inline Allocations on a new AUTHORISED credit note are checked and applied to the invoice, taking the amount off AmountDue and onto AmountCredited: by default the invoice may be AUTHORISED or PAID and the amount is bounded by the credit note total, and under strict_auth the invoice must be AUTHORISED and the amount within its AmountDue; both rules are guesses declared as alloc-001 and alloc-002) and GET CreditNotes (lists a tenant's credit notes, filtered by where and paged as GET Invoices is: the pagination object appears only when page is sent, and the form without page omits line items; there are no ID, number or status filters, as in Xero, and order and If-Modified-Since are not served yet). Webhooks are registered through admin routes under /admin/webhooks, which stand in for Xero's developer portal: registration runs the intent-to-receive check, and enabled subscriptions receive signed deliveries, one POST per event in write order. Writes emit events: PUT Contacts emits CONTACT CREATE; PUT Invoices emits INVOICE CREATE for each invoice created; POST Invoices/{InvoiceID} emits INVOICE UPDATE, a void or delete included; PUT CreditNotes emits CREDITNOTE CREATE with data {Type, Status}, plus INVOICE UPDATE once per invoice its inline Allocations moved; POST Payments emits INVOICE UPDATE once per touched invoice and, for a credit note payment, CREDITNOTE UPDATE once per credit note, after the final status is known; deleting a payment emits INVOICE UPDATE for the restored invoice, or CREDITNOTE UPDATE for a credit note payment; a refused write emits nothing; the event types, their casing and these causes are guesses, unverified against real Xero, and contact and credit note UPDATE writes do not exist yet. The remaining Xero Accounting routes arrive in later slices of build plan xero-bp1.
